title: Close exactly once
hints: Checking closed and then setting it is two steps. Two goroutines can both see false before either sets true, and then both release the connection.
atomic.Bool's CompareAndSwap(false, true) succeeds for exactly one caller. Everyone else gets false and should return ErrClosed.
if !c.closed.CompareAndSwap(false, true) { return ErrClosed }; c.release(); return nil  — with closed declared as atomic.Bool
